facts.fact: HISP WCA reports that the Ministry of Health's Directorate of the National Health Information System and IT (DSNISI) leads the audit and correction of data elements, indicators and metadata in the national SNIS DHIS2, with HISP WCA technical support.

HISP WCA reports that the Ministry of Health is auditing and correcting data elements, indicators and metadata by programme in the DHIS2 of Togo's National Health Information System (SNIS), run by its DSNISI.

TGO.note: A technical workshop on health metadata with HISP WCA; no consultation of people outside government on a digital law or policy.
